title: Closed shape tracks
author: L’âge tendre
description: Exact float64 line/cubic sections and curved-field polygon tracks. Opt in through chart.plugins.

fields.doc: Shape tracks; notes use the same light ID namespace as legacy lights.
Unique integer, not shared by lights.

Union of charter TrackShape.to_dict objects. Each component may contain holes. Coordinates/handles: |x| <= 8, |t| <= 86400 s; at most 32 components, 32 holes/component, 512 nodes/path. Aggregate compilation budgets are documented in README and reject, never truncate.
Closed path nodes [x,t,smooth]; x is normalized, t is chart seconds.
One segment per node: [linear|in|out|inout], or [bezier,h1x,h1t,h2x,h2t]. The final segment closes the path.
Even-odd holes subtracted from this component, using the same nodes/segs model.
Charter property keys {t,a,tint}; a=-1 is legacy default, otherwise 0..1; tint=-1 or 0..9.
Original event extras keyed by six-decimal seconds.
Original sweep-end knots, preserved for editor roundtrip.
Original pulse events, preserved for editor roundtrip.
Editor open-ended lifetime marker; the serialized outline bounds game geometry.
Converter-owned original sidecar record and approximate light events; never executed. Preserves unchanged editor export values.
